config.start_skill: Use /workspace/CTF_WP. Tasks are already isolated; do not create a Git worktree unless explicitly requested. Expected: 13 skill links, sapper 1.0.0, a valid temporary fact graph and 64 passing tests. No background services are required. See docs/environment.md for observed Debian 13.6 x86_64 system details, runtime versions and usage. Read .agents/skills/*/SKILL.md for individual skills. No project graph or hooks are initialized.
